source.name: Our World in Data based on certified LCA reports; Poore and Nemecek (2018)
source.additionalInfo:
This dataset has been compiled by Our World in Data based on a range of publicly available carbon footprinting reports of the environmental impacts of meat substitute products. The sources for each is individually listed below.

The global averages for meat and for plant foods (e.g tofu and peas) are sourced from Poore, J., & Nemecek, T. (2018). [Reducing food’s environmental impacts through producers and consumers](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aaq0216). Science, 360(6392), 987-992.

MorningStar products are sourced from "A comparative Life Cycle Assessment of plant-based foods and meat foods: Assessing the environmental benefits of plant a comparison of meal choices, a comparison of meat products and MorningStar Farms veggie products". This was a 2016 report prepared by Quantis. Available at: https://www.morningstarfarms.com/content/dam/NorthAmerica/morningstarfarms/pdf/MSFPlantBasedLCAReport_2016-04-10_Final.pdf

Mycoprotein and Quorn products are sourced from the Carbon Trust (2021). Available at: https://www.quorn.co.uk/assets/files/content/Carbon-Trust-Comparison-Report-2021.pdf

Impossible Burger data was sourced from its report, conducted by Quantis: "Comparative environmental LCA of the Impossible Burger® with conventional ground beef burger" Available at: https://assets.ctfassets.net/hhv516v5f7sj/4exF7Ex74UoYku640WSF3t/cc213b148ee80fa2d8062e430012ec56/Impossible_foods_comparative_LCA.pdf

Beyond Meat data was sourced from its report: "Beyond Meat's Beyond Burger Life Cycle Assessment: A detailed comparison between a plant-based and an animal-based protein source". Available at: https://css.umich.edu/sites/default/files/publication/CSS18-10.pdf

Cultivated (lab-grown meat) data is sourced from Sinke and Odegard (2021). LCA of cultivated meat: future projections for different scenarios. Available at: https://cedelft.eu/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/04/CE_Delft_190107_LCA_of_cultivated_meat_Def.pdf
